svg.title: Q-NEXUS: data model
svg.desc: Tender (tender): The client's tender with deadline, KTT, MQS and GM Engineering; owns the team members and the dated stage schedule. Procurement (paket): One RFQ List row and one procurement, with its stage, RFQ approval status and persons in charge per discipline. BOQ and items (daftar_boq, boq_item): Versioned bill of quantities per procurement; removed items are marked, not deleted, and items may link to the catalogue. Vendor (vendor): Vendor master with contacts, categories, umbrella contracts and blacklist status. RFQ and recipients (rfq, rfq_vendor): The request for quotation of a procurement and the vendors it was sent to, with the BOQ revision each holds. Quotation and TBE (quotation, quotation_harga, rfq_tbe): A vendor's offer with its technical and commercial evaluation, FINAL flag and unit price per BOQ item, plus the TBE matrix score per vendor. Clarification (klarifikasi): A question to a vendor about a quotation, from draft through sending to the recorded answer. Sessions and rounds (jadwal_sesi, putaran_negosiasi): Scheduled clarification or negotiation sessions and each negotiation round with price before and after. Catalogue and price records (material, catatan_harga): Item catalogue and the Price Database records, each traced to a procurement or to a past project contract. Reference prices (initial_price, target_pagu): The QS Initial Price per item and the KTT's budget ceiling, one per procurement. Selected vendor and archive (vendor_terpilih, arsip_paket): At most one selected vendor per procurement, keyed on the procurement, and the closing record with its result. Audit (audit): Append-only log of every workflow action with actor, class and reason, protected by a database trigger.
